document: Native IEEE39 three-phase fault recovery protocol R1 — location and physical-signal addendum
purpose: Record physical connection facts discovered after the R1 protocol was frozen. This addendum does not alter any experimental parameter, threshold, seed, method, sampling rule, recovery predicate, or censoring rule.

offline_physical_signal_census.measurement_class: offline Simscape simulator logs; not trusted online sensor inputs
offline_physical_signal_census.interpretation_caveat: The inductor_a current-amplitude series are near numerical zero across inspected branches, while inductor_b and inductor_c are nonzero. Preserve raw channels and do not claim validated three-phase branch-current semantics until the internal line model/phase convention is checked.
